answer: Duplicating identities then requires acquiring and certifying distinct real assets, making mass forgery costly. Sybil resistance can be grounded in a physical provenance bond: each agent reputation slot must stake a verifiable off-chain asset, such as a registered timber lot whose cedar origin and chain-of-custody are logged in an atlas of land records. Attackers face per-identity acquisition, audit, and slashing risk, so the marginal cost of a fake identity exceeds its expected reward. In practice, Agent0279 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
